name: List Record Fields
description: List record fields for a given Odoo model. Use this to discover available fields and select specific attributes (like `string`, `type`, and `help`). Gotchas: this action calls Odoo’s `fields_get` endpoint, so returned fields depend on your Odoo access rights. [See the documentation](https://www.odoo.com/documentation/18.0/developer/reference/external_api.html#list-record-fields)
